general_information.Description: The Graduation Thesis is an integrative experience that brings together various components of the undergraduate marketing studies in a more applied setting and under a new perspective. It enables students to further their knowledge and skills in marketing and related topics which they have found to be especially interesting or beneficial to them. As part of the course, students will learn about all aspects of the process of developing and carrying out the graduation thesis and gain an understanding of standards and expectations needed to successfully complete their dissertation. This thesis project will be completed by a group of 4-6 students, however each student will defend the thesis individually in front of a thesis committee. Each group of students will be supported by a supervisor, who will provide them with essential guidance in conducting a research, writing a thesis in a formal format and defending their arguments in front of the examination board. The thesis' topic is concerned with such areas as (1) marketing mix analysis and solutions, (2) marketing channels, conflicts and distribution, (3) integrated marketing communications - analysis of campaigns or activities, (4) branding strategy, (5) new product development and innovation marketing, (6) ethics in marketing, (7) marketing in the services context and (8) contemporary issues in marketing in Vietnam.
general_information.StudentTasks: (1)Choose the project within the selected concentration (2)Divide and schedule work (3)Attend at least 80% of scheduled meetings with their supervisor(s) to be eligible for the thesis or capstone defense (4)Produce document and product according to project requirement (5)Defense individually work in front of examination board

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Formulate, scope and position a research report within an appropriate literature
Generate a professional or theoretical research question and appropriate methodology.
Collect appropriate data, analyse according to the research problem and draw relevant conclusions.
Present and argue a position in a professional manner within a group setting.
Fulfil the requirements for conducting research in a professional and ethical manner.

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Report 2: Literature Review and Theoretical models

assessments.Grading Guide: • Based on the schedule in the syllabus, each group report will be evaluated by the group supervisor. This evaluation is called progress assessment. • Individual mark for each progress assessment report is decided by the group supervisor and is assessed on the basis of the actual contribution by that individual to the group report. The individual mark can be lower or higher than the group mark and is in the range from 0% to 120% of the group mark where the average score of group members cannot be more than group mark.
